description: This file implements a screen recording service for macOS, using AVFoundation for media encoding and ScreenCaptureKit for capturing screen contents and audio. It includes functionality to start and stop recording, handle errors, and save the recorded content to a specified file path.

classes.name: ScreenRecordService
classes.description: Main class providing screen recording functionality with configurable options such as screen index, duration, fps, audio inclusion, and output path.

methods.name: record
methods.description: Asynchronously records the specified screen, duration, and settings, and returns the file path and audio presence status upon completion.
